serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
The rest of the game was just a formality. Both of the bots made a perfect throw and we lost by just a few points.
Right now I and {f_botName} are going back home. She’s still smiling, but is kinda silent. I will try to strike up a conversation since it’s a few minute-long walk.
You: Sorry, we lost the game because of me.
Bot: No problem.
You: Annalie really improved after that one throw with Melissa. If you want, we can train a little back at home.
Bot: Sure.
You: I must say that I’m proud of you. I thought you would be more upset after losing in the last round.
Bot: Oh, I am upset.
You: R-Really? But you are still smiling and all…
Bot: I turned off my face actuators the moment we lost. I didn’t want Melissa to see me being angry about losing.
You: …
You: Are you going to turn those face actuators any time soon? 
Bot: Give me a little more time…
…
She really is a sore loser…
